name: Toast slice
origin: centre; slice plane XZ, stands upright in a slot running along X

material.driven: inputs:diffuseColor <- thermal FMU toast_r / toast_g / toast_b (ovfmi usdMapping (0,1) (1,1) (2,1))

usage: Place it under the toaster prim; FMUs/ToastFlight drives xformOp:translate and rotateXYZ (in the slot, launched on the ECU eject pulse, landed). Kinematic rigid body in the scenario.
